definitions.twoway: CIs of the incident-only (P2-C) bootstrap vs the two-way incident x source-episode multiple-membership bootstrap (revision.episode_pool_sampler; clusters = library episodes + D3 look-alikes from gen.json; variant episodes+bgtiles adds 30-min tiles of the background capture); se_ratio = SE_two-way / SE_incident
definitions.lagstr: STR restricted to T* transitions by generator lag (gen.json edge lag_s; bridges over hidden episodes = sum of hop lags): long = above the pool median, short = at or below; Q1-Q4 quartiles; gt600 = lag > 600 s; oracle = r_C-limited ceiling of each group
definitions.decoy: strata of test incidents by decoy composition (gen.json n_D1/n_D2/n_D3; calibration unchanged) and the endpoint-kind classes of certified FALSE claims (share over 200 splits)
